entities.name: UniProt Q9S9P2
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana probable CCR4-associated factor 1 homolog 2; 286 aa.
UniProt describes it as a component of the CCR4 complex involved in control of gene expression (by similarity).
Annotated localization: nucleus and cytoplasm; GO cellular components include CCR4-NOT core complex and P-body.
GO annotations include poly(A)-specific ribonuclease activity and nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening; biological-process annotation includes defense response to bacterium.
Two CAF1 family Pfam hits occur at residues 19–145 and 168–214.

entities.name: CCR4-NOT complex
observations: The exact-match Arabidopsis protein is annotated as part of the CCR4-NOT core complex and associated with gene-expression control.

entities.name: mRNA poly(A) shortening
observations: The exact-match protein has GO annotations for poly(A)-specific ribonuclease activity and nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening.
